notes.title: Quick patch - v1.0.10
notes.content:
Version 1.0.10
After some comments in the discussions group we noticed that people couldn't get the one hand free achievement triggered....

It has been fixed now.  Please let us know any issues you might have in the discussion groups. Leaving thumbs down is not the way to proceed, so please, leave bugs, comments or your questions in the comments section, we take actions with every comment, you know that!

:)

notes.title: Quick Patch - v 1.0.8
notes.content:
Version 1.0.8.

- Bosses HP revised in higher levels.
- Saving companion (only multiplayer) is cheaper now.
- Japanese language fixes.
- Other language fixes.
- Other small HUD fixes.

notes.title: Quick patch - v 1.0.6
notes.content:
Version 1.0.6
- Minor shop tweaks.
- Portuguese language added.
- Beginner mode added. Useful when you feel that Standard mode is still too hard for you.
It unlocks after a few unsuccessful attempts trying to complete the game in Standard mode. If you complete the game at least once, it will disappear. However if you own the DLC, it will appear always.
- Some other minor menu tweaks.

notes.title: Quick patch - v 1.0.4
notes.content:
Version 1.0.4
- 'Filthy Thief' achievement fixed.
- More Expert mode tweaks.
- Mode hidden stages' tweaks.
- New cloud enemy.

notes.title: Quick patch - v1.0.2
notes.content:
Version 1.0.2 

Fixes:
- Scanlines not going away in the FULLY CENSORED MODE "TYPE - I"
- Some difficulty tweaks in hidden stages.
- Expert mode tweaks.


Additional notes about Exposed DLC:
'Fully censored'. censored, uncensored and 'totally uncensored' are accessible from the game. You only need to play for a bit to unlock those modes.

DLC would unlock them straight away but keep in mind that it is not necessary to unlock them via gameplay and this is how it was designed. DLC is there only to help some players but it is not required by any means.

notes.title: RC patch: 0.9.60
notes.content:
Patch 0.9.60
- A few balance fixes.
- Prevention of too much score farming.
- Some improvements in the shop.
- Improved "HURRY UP" panels.
- Bonus levels are easier now.
- Some small fixes in some WAIFUS.
- Achievements implemented in BETA.
- Implemented Japanese logo.
- Small ship tweaks.
- All languages enabled. Please let us know if you can fin typos or other problems.

This is supposed to be final patch, please let us know if you encounter any issues.
If you do, please let us know how to replicate them but also make sure you enable BETA version first. It will enables Error reporting and will provide us valuable data in case you find a crash.

notes.title: Version 0.8.20
notes.content:
This new version contains:

- 1 new playable Waifu: Lady Ariella. (Vampiress)
- Lots and lots of bug fixes.
- Many tweaks in game balance.
- More text typos fixed.
- Fixed some more game-crashes.

Remember if it crashes, please enable (and download) BETA mode via game properties in Steam. It has the ability to generate crash-reports: those are helping us greatly.

notes.title: Version 0.7.0
notes.content:
This new version contains:

- 1 new playable Waifu: Tempesta. (Demoniac waifu)
- Lots and lots of bug fixes.
- Many tweaks in game balance.
- More text typos fixed.
- Fixed some found game-crashes.

- Wakely becomes available in Standard mode

Remember if it crashes, please enable (and download) BETA mode via game properties in Steam. It has the ability to generate crash-reports: those are helping us greatly.

notes.title: Patch 0.6.16
notes.content:
Version 0.6.16 is up.

Upgrades / enhancements:
- game stability 
- more enemy types
- more game-balance
- player ships tweaked
- text typos fixed
- long enemies work as intended now.
- more variety in bonus stages
- bosses have been rebalanced
- new attack types
- shop prices
- Quick scanlines access via [F9]
- broken glass can be cleared from screen with a bomb
- and more small things.

Since we changed a lot of code some new things could be broken. Please let us know we will fix anything as fast as humanly possible.  :)

NOTE: We had to ERASE many scores in leaderboards because noticed a glitch that would give you instantly 8 millions and that could be used many times during the same game. We did some testing and we could get to 30million without the glitch so, all 12 scores higher than that have been removed. Sorry if you played fairly, we know you can do it again.

THANKS FOR PLAYING.
